skills.name: Talking about means of transport; reading about a journey

note.text:
Ngwa travelled from Buea to Bamenda last Saturday. He bought a ticket at the agency office in the motor park. The bus left at seven o'clock. The driver checked every passenger's seat belt and the conductor loaded the luggage. The bus stopped at a checkpoint and at a roadside market. They arrived in the afternoon, and Ngwa's uncle was waiting for him.
Talking about transport:
• How do you travel to Bamenda? — I travel by bus. (by bus, by taxi, by train, by plane; but on foot)
• How long does the journey take? — About six hours.
• How much is the fare? — Five thousand francs.
Public transport is transport everyone can pay to use: buses, taxis, trains, ferries, planes.

worked_example.problem: {n} goes to {p} every Saturday by {t}. Write two questions about her journey and her answers.
steps: To ask about the means of transport, use How: “How do you go to {p}?” — “I go by {t}.”
To ask about time, use How long: “How long does the journey take?” — “About half an hour.”
Remember: by + the means of transport, with no a or the (by {t}); but on foot.
worked_example.answer: “How do you go to {p}?” — “I go by {t}.” “How long does the journey take?” — “About half an hour.”

cards.idea: Read the text about Ngwa's journey. It answers: who, where, how, when and what happened.
example: Ngwa travelled from Buea to Bamenda last Saturday. He went to the motor park early in the morning and bought a ticket at the agency office.
The bus left at seven o'clock. The driver checked that every passenger wore a seat belt, and the conductor put the luggage on the roof.
The road was good, but the bus stopped at a police checkpoint and for a short break at a roadside market, where Ngwa bought roasted plantains.
They arrived in Bamenda in the afternoon. Ngwa was tired but happy: his uncle was waiting for him at the park.

pick.q: Where did Ngwa buy his ticket?
e: He bought it before the journey, at the agency office.
He bought roasted plantains at the market, not his ticket.
His uncle met him in Bamenda.
pick.y: The text says he bought a ticket at the agency office.

pick.q: Who put the luggage on the roof?
e: The driver checked the seat belts.
pick.y: The text says the conductor put the luggage on the roof.

pick.q: Why did the bus stop on the way?
pick.r: at a checkpoint and for a short break
e: The text does not say the bus broke down.
The text does not talk about rain.
The text does not talk about fuel.
pick.y: It stopped at a police checkpoint and at a roadside market.

pick.q: How did Ngwa feel when he arrived?
e: Nothing in the text shows he was angry.
Nothing in the text shows he was afraid.
pick.y: The text says he was tired but happy.

pick.q: When did they arrive in Bamenda?
e: Seven o'clock is when the bus left.
pick.y: The text says they arrived in the afternoon.

cards.idea: Say “by” + the means of transport, with no a or the: by bus, by taxi, by train, by plane. But: on foot.
example: I travel to Bamenda by bus.
Mih walks: she goes to school on foot.

e: We say by train, not with train.

pick.s: My brother goes to school ___ foot.
e: Walking is on foot, not by foot.

pick.s: The minister flew to Garoua ___ plane.
e: With by, there is no a: by plane.

pick.s: Do you go to the market ___ taxi?
e: Without the, we say by taxi.
We say by canoe, not with canoe.

cards.idea: Ask about a journey with How (which transport), How long (time), How much (money) and When (the day or the hour).
example: How much is the fare? — It is five thousand francs.
When does the bus leave? — At seven o'clock.

pick.q: How do you travel to Kumba?
w: The fare is two thousand francs.
pick.y: How asks about the means of transport.

pick.q: How long does the journey take?
Where does the bus to Limbe leave from?
pick.r: From the motor park in Mile 17.

questions.prompt: Tap the words in the right order.
One sentence has a mistake. Which one?

right.text: I travel to Limbe by bus.
She goes to school on foot.
We travelled by train last year.
How long does the journey take?

wrong.text: He goes to school by foot.
wrong.explain: Walking is on foot, not by foot.

wrong.text: We travelled to Douala by the train.
wrong.explain: After by there is no the: by train.
The fare is money: How much is the fare?
